cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.

mechanism: A governs the acceptable form and audience of endorsement so a supporter visible to potential critics protects A rota decision.
confusable: D31 seeks backing for a version; D52 needs an identifiable endorsement that makes later challenge harder, with A approving the medium and reach.
comparison: A staff rota endorsement can become a copied email, unlike the extension alternative signatures and de-anonymized initials.
seedUse: The existing D52-a final directive turns B medium request into controlled public reach, sustaining superior approval of endorsement terms.
